meta.title: beamlynx - Click through your database
meta.description: Beamlynx is a visual database client for PostgreSQL and MySQL. Click from one table to the next and the query writes itself.
meta.ogDescription: A visual database client. Click from table to table and the query writes itself.
meta.twitterDescription: A visual database client. Click from table to table and the query writes itself.

hero.description: beamlynx draws your tables and how they connect. Pick a table, follow a link to the next one, and the rows appear as you go. The query sits beside the picture, in case you'd rather type.
hero.facts: macOS, Windows and Linux · PostgreSQL and MySQL · No account

showcase.alt: The beamlynx app. On the left, three tables (customers, orders and product_reviews) are drawn as boxes joined by lines, with the matching query underneath. On the right, a table of results.
showcase.caption: The real app, on a sample shop database. Nothing here is mocked up.

try.heading: Three clicks. No SQL.
try.description: This works like the app, on the same sample data. Each click adds a step, and the results follow.
try.hintFilter: Click + rating = 5 to keep only the five-star reviews.
try.hintDone: Done. Switch to SQL to see what beamlynx wrote for you.
try.sqlWritten_one: {{count}} character of SQL written for you
try.sqlWritten_other: {{count}} characters of SQL written for you

agents.heading: Let an AI agent look around. Keep the keys.
agents.description: beamlynx has a built-in MCP server. Any AI agent that supports MCP can explore the databases you allow, the same way you do: one table at a time.

readOnly.title: It can only read.
readOnly.description: Updates and deletes are refused, by the server and by the app.

approval.title: Hidden columns stay hidden.
approval.description: To see one, the agent has to ask, and you approve or decline in the app.

visible.title: You see what it sees.
visible.description: Every query it runs shows up in beamlynx, in a tab marked as the agent's. Agents are asked to start each one with a note on what they're looking for.

agents.cardLabel: Example of a query an AI agent sent

closing.heading: Connect a database and see what's in there.
closing.description: No account and no server to set up. On a Mac, <1>Homebrew works too</1>.
